HTML
components.content:
The Attorney General of British Columbia is now accepting online service of the following documents, through the Serve Legal portal:

  • Notice of Constitutional Question
  • Notice of Civil Claim
  • Petition to the Court and supporting Affidavit(s)
  • Notice of Appeal
  • Notice of Claim (small claims)
  • Notice of Application and supporting Affidavit(s)
How It Works

To serve one of these documents on the Attorney General of British Columbia, please fill out the form below. Once your document is submitted, an email acknowledging receipt will be sent to the “contact email” within 1 business day.

If you do not receive an email confirming receipt within 1 business day, please contact aglsblitigationect@gov.bc.ca. For clarity, service is not effected until an email acknowledgement has been provided. Under no circumstances will the Attorney General of British Columbia accept online service of documents which are not listed above.

components.label: HTML
components.content:
Note
This portal is currently only available to serve certain specified filed court documents and their supporting documents (listed above and in the “Document Type” field in the form). For more methods of service for other documents, please see Serving Legal Documents on the Attorney General of British Columbia .

workflows.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:modeler="http://camunda.org/schema/modeler/1.0" id="Definitions_19mue86" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="Camunda Modeler" exporterVersion="5.48.0" modeler:executionPlatform="Camunda Platform" modeler:executionPlatformVersion="7.15.0">
  <bpmn:process id="servelegaldocuments" name="servelegaldocuments" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:documentation>Top-level orchestrator for a "serve legal documents" application, from
intake through the staff document-review loop to served-date verification
and notification.

Flow:
1. ReceiveDocumentsStartEvent sets applicationStatus and dates, then calls
   Save request data (Initial create) (SaveRequestDataProcess, method=POST)
   to create the servedDocuments record.
2. Check Served Date in Parallel forks into two branches that run
   concurrently:
   a. The document-review loop: Document Review (staff user task) ->
      Is complete? gateway, which routes on the task's 'action' value:
        - COMPLETE: signals CancelVerifyServedDate-${applicationId} (cancels
          branch b below if it's still running), then Save request data
          (completed) (PUT) -> end.
        - SAVE: Save request data (save) (PUT), then loops back to the same
          user task.
        - anything else: loops back to the same user task without saving.
      A boundary signal event on the user task
      (UpdateServedDate-${applicationId}) lets branch b push a new
      servedDate into the open task's form without waiting for the task to
      complete.
   b. Verify served date (VerifyServedDateProcess): waits for a valid
      business day/time, sends the "served" email, and saves the served
      date. A boundary signal event (CancelVerifyServedDate-${applicationId})
      lets branch a cancel this branch if staff complete the document
      first.

Method used at each SaveRequestDataProcess call site (see that process's own
documentation for the POST/PUT retry-safety design):
  Save request data (Initial create) -> POST
  Save request data (save)           -> PUT
  Save request data (completed)      -> PUT

Known gap: none of these call activities (nor Verify served date) have a
boundary error event — an unresolved failure in any of them, or in
EmailNotificationProcess (triggered deep inside Verify served date), surfaces
only as a Camunda incident with no business-visible failure state.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="ReceiveDocumentsStartEvent" name="Receive documents" camunda:asyncBefore="true">
      <bpmn:documentation>Action Performed:

(1) Set application status to Received and set dates (Listener Tab)
(2) Sync applicaionId and applicationStatus to form (Listener Tab)
(3) Create an audit history entry (Listener Tab)</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable('applicationStatus','Received - No Served Email sent yet');

var tmpDate = new Date().toLocaleString();
execution.setVariable('receiveddate',tmpDate);
execution.setVariable('dateSubmitted',tmpDate);

var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.info("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  New Submission", timestamp, applicationId);

var nextApperanceDateInISOFormat = execution.hasVariable('nextAppearanceDate') ? new Date(nextAppearanceDate).toISOString() : null;

execution.setVariable('serveDateInISOFormat', null);
execution.setVariable('nextApperanceDateInISOFormat', nextApperanceDateInISOFormat);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
        <camunda:executionListener class="org.camunda.bpm.extension.hooks.listeners.ApplicationStateListener" event="end"/>
        <camunda:executionListener class="org.camunda.bpm.extension.hooks.listeners.BPMFormDataPipelineListener" event="end">
          <camunda:field name="fields">
            <camunda:expression>["applicationId", "applicationStatus","dateSubmitted"]</camunda:expression>
          </camunda:field>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1teuejl</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1teuejl" sourceRef="ReceiveDocumentsStartEvent" targetRef="SaveRequestDataInitialCreateCallActivity"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="DocumentStatusStaffGroupTask" name="Document Review" camunda:asyncAfter="true" camunda:candidateGroups="servelegal-staff" camunda:dueDate="${serveDateInISOFormat}" camunda:followUpDate="${nextApperanceDateInISOFormat}">
      <bpmn:documentation>User task
(1) Create a new form instance to store updates (Listener)
(2) When submitted it set the applicationStatus to the action and deleteReason to completd (Listener)</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:formData>
          <camunda:formField id="action" label="Action" type="string"/>
        </camunda:formData>
        <camunda:taskListener event="complete">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">task.getExecution().setVariable('applicationStatus', 'Submission accessed and modified by Province user');
task.getExecution().setVariable('deleteReason', "completed");</camunda:script>
        </camunda:taskListener>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.debug("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Document Review Task generated", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
        <camunda:executionListener event="end">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var nextApperanceDateInISOFormat = execution.hasVariable('nextAppearanceDate') ? new Date(nextAppearanceDate).toISOString() : null;

execution.setVariable('nextApperanceDateInISOFormat', nextApperanceDateInISOFormat);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>flowgateway_to_usertask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_usertask_to_gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="IsCompleteGateway" name="Is complete?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check whether form submission (task update) is the complete the form or to update the form.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1ivz1ag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>YesSequenceFlow</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SavedSequenceFlow</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CatchAllFlowSequenceFlow</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="DocumentCompletedEndEvent" name="Document completed">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.info("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Document Completed", timestamp, applicationId);
</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_savereqiestdata_to_end</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="YesSequenceFlow" name="Yes" sourceRef="IsCompleteGateway" targetRef="CancelVerifyThrowEvent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${action == "COMPLETE"}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="CancelVerifyThrowEvent" name="Cancel verify branch">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.info("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Cancelling VerifyServedDate branch (document completed)", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>YesSequenceFlow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_cancel_to_completed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_CancelVerify" signalRef="Signal_CancelVerify"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_cancel_to_completed" sourceRef="CancelVerifyThrowEvent" targetRef="SaveRequestDataCompletedCallActivity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SavedSequenceFlow" name="Saved" sourceRef="IsCompleteGateway" targetRef="SaveRequestDataSaveCallActivity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${action == "SAVE"}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="SaveRequestDataInitialCreateCallActivity" name="Save request data (Initial create)" camunda:asyncBefore="true" calledElement="save-request-data-process">
      <bpmn:documentation>(1) Call Subprocess to create document submission in central db
(2) set the http method to be used for API call (Listener)
(3) Make sure dateSubmitted is set before this.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:in businessKey="${execution.getVariable("applicationId").toString()}"/>
        <camunda:in source="applicationId" target="applicationId"/>
        <camunda:in source="formUrl" target="formUrl"/>
        <camunda:in source="method" target="method"/>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable('method','POST');

var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.debug("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Save Initial Data", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1teuejl</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_saverequest_to_gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="SaveRequestDataSaveCallActivity" name="Save request data (save)" camunda:asyncBefore="true" calledElement="save-request-data-process">
      <bpmn:documentation>(1) Call Subprocess to update document submission in central db
(2) set the http method to be used for API call (Listener)</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:in businessKey="#{execution.getVariable("applicationId").toString()}"/>
        <camunda:in source="applicationId" target="applicationId"/>
        <camunda:in source="formUrl" target="formUrl"/>
        <camunda:in source="method" target="method"/>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable('method','PUT');

var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.debug("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Save Working Data:", timestamp, applicationId);
</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
        <camunda:executionListener class="org.camunda.bpm.extension.hooks.listeners.FormSubmissionListener" event="start"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>SavedSequenceFlow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_saverequestdata_to_usertask</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="VerifyServedDateCallActivity" name="Verify served date" camunda:asyncBefore="true" calledElement="verify-served-date-process">
      <bpmn:documentation>Call sub process to :
(1) Check the day and time of the day
(2) Send served email if its working and end
(3) If it's not a working time then send Received email
 Calculate earliest next working day and time.
(4) sleep until then and ten send served email</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:in businessKey="#{execution.getVariable("applicationId").toString()}"/>
        <camunda:in source="applicationId" target="applicationId"/>
        <camunda:in source="contactEmail" target="contactEmail"/>
        <camunda:in source="formUrl" target="formUrl"/>
        <camunda:in source="receiveddate" target="receiveddate"/>
        <camunda:in source="documentType" target="documentType"/>
        <camunda:out source="servedDate" target="servedDate"/>
        <camunda:out source="serveDateInISOFormat" target="serveDateInISOFormat"/>
        <camunda:out source="servedDateForDisplay" target="servedDateForDisplay"/>
        <camunda:out source="applicationStatus" target="applicationStatus"/>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.debug("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Verify Served Date started", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_gateway_to_verifyserveddate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_verifyserveddate_to_end</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="SaveRequestDataCompletedCallActivity" name="Save request data (completed)" camunda:asyncBefore="true" calledElement="save-request-data-process">
      <bpmn:documentation>(1) Call Subprocess to update document submission in central db
(2) set the http method to be used for API call (Listener)</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:in businessKey="#{execution.getVariable("applicationId").toString()}"/>
        <camunda:in source="applicationId" target="applicationId"/>
        <camunda:in source="formUrl" target="formUrl"/>
        <camunda:in source="method" target="method"/>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">execution.setVariable('method','PUT');

var closedDate = new Date().toISOString();
execution.setVariable('closedDate',closedDate);

var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.debug("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Saving Final Data", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
        <camunda:executionListener class="org.camunda.bpm.extension.hooks.listeners.BPMFormDataPipelineListener" event="start">
          <camunda:field name="fields">
            <camunda:expression>["closedDate"]</camunda:expression>
          </camunda:field>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_cancel_to_completed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_savereqiestdata_to_end</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_savereqiestdata_to_end" sourceRef="SaveRequestDataCompletedCallActivity" targetRef="DocumentCompletedEndEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_saverequestdata_to_usertask" sourceRef="SaveRequestDataSaveCallActivity" targetRef="MergeGateway1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_saverequest_to_gateway" sourceRef="SaveRequestDataInitialCreateCallActivity" targetRef="CheckServedDateInParallelGateway"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="CheckServedDateInParallelGateway" name="Check Served Date in Parallel">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_saverequest_to_gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_gateway_to_gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_gateway_to_verifyserveddate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_gateway_to_gateway" sourceRef="CheckServedDateInParallelGateway" targetRef="MergeGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_gateway_to_verifyserveddate" sourceRef="CheckServedDateInParallelGateway" targetRef="VerifyServedDateCallActivity"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="CancelVerifyBoundaryEvent" name="Document completed" attachedToRef="VerifyServedDateCallActivity">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();
logger.info("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Verify Served Date cancelled - document was completed by staff", timestamp, applicationId);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_cancel_to_emailend</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_BoundaryCancel" signalRef="Signal_CancelVerify"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_cancel_to_emailend" sourceRef="CancelVerifyBoundaryEvent" targetRef="EndAfterSendingEmailEndEvent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndAfterSendingEmailEndEvent" name="End After Sending Email">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_verifyserveddate_to_end</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_cancel_to_emailend</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_verifyserveddate_to_end" sourceRef="VerifyServedDateCallActivity" targetRef="EndAfterSendingEmailEndEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_usertask_to_usertask" sourceRef="ServeDateUpdateNotificationBoundaryEvent" targetRef="MergeGateway"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="ServeDateUpdateNotificationBoundaryEvent" name="Serve Date update notification" attachedToRef="DocumentStatusStaffGroupTask">
      <bpmn:documentation>(1) Update form with servedDate and applicationStatus.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:executionListener event="start">
          <camunda:script scriptFormat="javascript">var Logger = Java.type("org.slf4j.LoggerFactory");
var logger = Logger.getLogger("BPMN_SCRIPT");
var timestamp = new java.util.Date().toString();

logger.info("*********[Serve Legal] {} :: {} ::  Received UpdateServedDate-{} Signal with {}", timestamp, applicationId,applicationId,servedDate);</camunda:script>
        </camunda:executionListener>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_usertask_to_usertask</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_0479i73" signalRef="Signal_1gxsa4x"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CatchAllFlowSequenceFlow" name="Catch All Flow" sourceRef="IsCompleteGateway" targetRef="MergeGateway1">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${action != "Saved" && action != "Completed"}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MergeGateway" name="Merge" camunda:asyncBefore="true">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_usertask_to_usertask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_gateway_to_gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02yfjcy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flowgateway_to_usertask</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flowgateway_to_usertask" sourceRef="MergeGateway" targetRef="DocumentStatusStaffGroupTask"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MergeGateway1" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_saverequestdata_to_usertask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>CatchAllFlowSequenceFlow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02yfjcy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02yfjcy" sourceRef="MergeGateway1" targetRef="MergeGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_usertask_to_gateway" sourceRef="DocumentStatusStaffGroupTask" targetRef="SyncDataTask"/>
    <bpmn:task id="SyncDataTask" name="SyncData">
      <bpmn:documentation>Activity to manage the listners. Boundary event will fire 'end' activity in user task, so event listners should be moved away from user task</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
